'''Max Salven''' won the [[1997 Kiffex Regionals]]. He published constructed lists on Decipher Deck Designs and posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list.

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I come from Finland, and currently live in England."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/salven.html Max Salven], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428091822/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/salven.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"I will be 15 next January, making me one of the younger qualifiers."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I am a major Star Wars fan, collecting everything, not just the card game."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I originaly just collected it, but then I tried playing it, and from there I got involved with the listserv, and eventually got pretty good at the game."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"As for other hobbies beside Star Wars, well...umm...er..not much else really."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite movies are, surprise surprise, the Star Wars trilogy."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I am very excited about the World Championships, and I think I might use an all-Jawa Deck ;-)."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"If anyone wants to contact me, you can view my Web Site at http://hot.virtual-pc.com/mufty/swccg/intro.html (Star Wars CCG-related, of course =),."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"and for any of you Palace people, I am at most of the conferences, using the 'Mufty' handle."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Not much else to say, except I'd like to say 'Good Luck!' to all of the other qualifiers, and I look forward to meeting the Decipher Crew!"<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Best Regards, Max Salven."<ref name="dec97bio" />
